user.title: Connect to iSolarCloud
user.description: Enter your iSolarCloud API credentials. You can find them here: [iSolarCloud]({url})

data_description.app_id: App ID from iSolarCloud Developer Platform. To find this, go to your application and look for 'id' within the URL like so: {app_id_url}.

auth_callback.title: Waiting for authorization
auth_callback.description:
Open the link below to authorize the application:

{auth_url}

After you log in and approve the app, you will be redirected back and this screen will update automatically.

If the redirect does not complete (for example the page shows an error), wait a moment and you will be able to paste the code manually.

auth_manual.title: Enter Authorization Code
auth_manual.description:
The automatic redirect did not complete. Finish authorizing manually:

{auth_url}

**Instructions:**
1. Visit the link above and log in (skip if you already did).
2. You will be redirected (the page may show an error).
3. Copy the **code** parameter from the URL address bar.
4. Paste the code — or the full redirect URL — below.

data.code: Authorization Code or full redirect URL

error.invalid_extra_measure_points: Extra measure points must be in the form point_id=code, comma separated

abort.library_missing: The pysolarcloud library is not installed. Restart Home Assistant so the integration's requirements are installed, then try again.
abort.missing_code: Authorization code was not received. Please try again.

init.title: Sungrow Options
init.description: Adjust how often Home Assistant polls iSolarCloud. Lower values update more frequently but use more of your API quota. The free plan allows ~2000 calls/hour; the minimum is 10 seconds.
